title: Salsa for Beginners
summary: Jackie teaches you three dance moves at a Kabuki corner club, while a crowd claps if you keep up.
description: Jackie offers V a dance lesson at a corner club in Kabuki, with three moves to learn and a crowd to clap if V keeps up. He says V is terrible, and he is free.

start.bringUp: Jackie invites you to a dance lesson at a club in Kabuki tonight at ten. He says you are terrible and he is free.

g1.asks: Can you feel the beat? No? Close your eyes. What does it sound like to you?
g1.know: You are at the club in Kabuki with Jackie. A stranger has asked Jackie to dance and taken the lead, and you have missed one move.
g1.secret: Dancing makes him feel closest to his mother.
